questions: Should EXECUTE be fully removed from CLI VALID_MODES or kept alongside PLAY?

answers.answer: Replace EXECUTE with PLAY in VALID_MODES. EXECUTE has 0 production tickets. The CLI performs client-side validation (create.ts:79-88) before the API call, so removing EXECUTE from VALID_MODES prevents users from selecting it. The server API still accepts EXECUTE via the Zod enum (backwards compatibility), but no user path should create new EXECUTE tickets. Update all 5 help/documentation text locations to show PLAY instead of EXECUTE.
evidence: create.ts:79-88 — CLI validates mode against VALID_MODES before sending to API
Research report: EXECUTE=0 production tickets, safe to replace
Help text at create.ts:17, index.ts:21, index.ts:73 — all reference EXECUTE

statement: The helix-cli replaces EXECUTE with PLAY in the VALID_MODES array and updates all 5 help/documentation text locations. Three files change: create.ts (VALID_MODES + help text), index.ts (2 usage strings), cli-content.ts (2 documentation references). This is a straightforward text-level change with no architectural decisions.
